mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_bill ( bill_no, activity_id, user_id, total_work_minutes, base_amount, hour_amount, reward_amount, deduct_amount, total_amount, bill_status ) VALUES ( #{billNo}, #{activityId}, #{userId}, #{totalWorkMinutes}, #{baseAmount}, #{hourAmount}, #{rewardAmount}, #{deductAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{billStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, bill_no, activity_id, user_id, total_work_minutes, base_amount, hour_amount, reward_amount, deduct_amount, total_amount, bill_status FROM settlement_bill WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, bill_no, activity_id, user_id, total_work_minutes, base_amount, hour_amount, reward_amount, deduct_amount, total_amount, bill_status FROM settlement_bill WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
